newsitem.title: USA: Brent steady in late U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent steady in late U.S. paper trading.

text.p: North Sea Brent blend crude oil was steady in forward contract trading late in the U.S. day during the "window" to set the reference price for Tuesday, traders said.
July Brent paper traded at $17.72 a barrel for a full cargo and at $17.75 and $17.73 for partials. August traded at $17.83.
July traded against August at a 31-cent discount for two full cargo sizes, at 31 cents under for a cargo and August against September at a 19 cent discount for a cargo size.
Various traders were involved and there was no featured buyer or seller.
